profile_text.body:
Zoom is a publicly traded collaboration software company (ticker: ZM, CIK: 0001585521) founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Jose, California. Its own site describes the company as offering a single platform of tools that includes video meetings, Zoom Chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center, and events, with a stated goal of modernizing workflows.

On the AI side, Zoom offers a product called Zoom AI Companion, which the site positions as a built-in assistant that summarizes meetings and automates next steps. The site also references a feature called ZoomMate, described as going further by generating assets such as decks and documents. Zoom AI Companion is categorized as a chat and general large language model product, and recording consent is noted as a relevant consideration for its meeting summarization functionality.

The held facts indicate Zoom has 181 points of legal exposure indexed under California, though no specific cases are recorded in the current data.
